rca of the issue: IFRS page DPDP-copy leak — RCA: CustomServiceDetail() in /app/frontend/src/pages/ServiceDetailPage.jsx was originally written for DPDP only and the H2 'Three integrated practices — engineered for DPDP Act readiness.' was hardcoded directly in JSX (line ~339). When the IFRS-Ind-AS service was added with content.image + content.pillars, it reused the same component without parameterising the heading. Reproduction: visit /services/financial-advisory/ifrs-ind-as-advisory, scroll to the 'How we deliver' section. Mitigation: add a `pillarsHeading` (and optionally `automationIntroCopy`) field to /app/frontend/src/data/service-content.js entries and read it in CustomServiceDetail with a sensible default.
